name: Ahaziah
bio: Ahaziah, son of Ahab and successor to his throne, began to reign over Israel in Samaria in Jehoshaphat's seventeenth year as king of Judah, reigning two years (1 Kings 22:51). He did evil in the LORD's eyes, walking in the ways of his father Ahab, his mother Jezebel, and Jeroboam son of Nebat, serving and worshipping Baal just as his father had done (1 Kings 22:52-53). He later asked Jehoshaphat to let his servants sail with Jehoshaphat's trading fleet to Ophir, but Jehoshaphat refused (1 Kings 22:49). His reign and its consequences are told in detail in the chapters ahead.
